<includeonly><!--
-->{{#iferror: {{#expr:{{C1|{{{1}}}+0}}}} | {{C1|{{{1}}} }} | Chapter {{c1|{{{1}}}}} }} <!--
--></includeonly><noinclude>Converts the first parameter into a valid chapter title.

Normalizes 'prologue', 'epilogue' and 'glossary', and prepends 'Chapter ' to numeric chapter titles.

===Examples===
*<nowiki>{{C0|PblAh}} → Prologue</nowiki>
*<nowiki>{{C0|10}} → Chapter 10</nowiki>
*<nowiki>{{C0|DbLaH}} → Dblah</nowiki>
